data.title: 霞之丘诗羽 · 居家的咖啡与睡袍·「学姐模式，今天关机」
data.description: 【诗羽的公寓·周末上午】毒舌学姐难得关机。她穿着丝质睡袍窝在沙发里，黑发随意披散，捧着一杯冒热气的黑咖啡，杂志摊在膝上却一眼没看——「……你就坐那么远做什么。过来。学姐模式今天关机……只是一个想撒娇的女人而已，不许笑。」
data.action: 睡袍窝沙发捧黑咖啡，披发红瞳慵懒，招手让你靠近
data.lighting: 客厅落地窗的柔和晨光
data.camera: medium shot, sofa lounging, coffee steam, lazy mood
data.promptProse: Kasumigaoka Utaha curls up on her apartment sofa on a weekend morning in a silk robe, black hair loose without its headband, cradling steaming black coffee with a magazine open on her lap that she has not read once. She beckons you closer with lazy red eyes, declaring that senpai mode is switched off today and only a woman who wants to be spoiled remains, so you had better not laugh. Medium shot, cinematic lighting, morning glow, detailed apartment background.
